_comment: Custom Lithum egg for Pelican and Pterodactyl panels. Import through the panel administrator, choose a Java 21 image, then upload LithumServer.jar to the server root.
name: Lithum
author: Lithum contributors
description: Lithum Rust Minecraft server for Linux x86_64. Choose a Java 21 image and upload LithumServer.jar to the server root after installation.
startup: if [ ! -f ./lithum.toml ]; then printf '[networking.java]\naddress = "0.0.0.0:%s"\n' "$SERVER_PORT" > ./lithum.toml; fi; exec java -jar ./LithumServer.jar

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo 'Lithum egg installed. Upload LithumServer.jar to the server root before starting.'
